gloss: to be effective; to work; to be possible

definitions.gloss: to be effective, to work, to take effect
definitions.explanation: Describes something functioning properly or producing the intended effect. Used for medicine, brakes, air conditioning, seasoning, etc.

definitions.gloss: to be possible, to be able to do
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something can be done or is available as an option. Often used in the pattern ～が利く.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}はよく{利|き}く。
エアコンが{利|き}いていて{涼|すず}しい。
examples.english: The air conditioning is working and it's cool.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{車|くるま}なのでブレーキの{利|き}きが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: It's an old car, so the brakes don't work well.

examples.japanese: {融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く{人|ひと}だ。
この{店|みせ}はカードが{利|き}く。
{小回|こまわ}りが{利|き}くので{狭|せま}い{道|みち}でも{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}だ。
examples.english: It's maneuverable, so even narrow roads are fine.

notes:
Written with the kanji {利|き}く to distinguish from the homophones {聞|き}く (to listen/ask) and {効|き}く (to be effective — more focused on medicinal or chemical effects). In practice, {利|き}く and {効|き}く overlap considerably for sense 1, but {利|き}く covers the broader meaning of functioning or being available.

CONJUGATION:
・{利|き}かない (negative)
・{利|き}きます (polite)
・{利|き}いた (past)
・{利|き}いて (te-form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ブレーキが{利|き}く — the brakes work
・{融通|ゆうずう}が{利|き}く — to be flexible/adaptable
・{小回|こまわ}りが{利|き}く — to be maneuverable
・{気|き}が{利|き}く — to be considerate/attentive
・つぶしが{利|き}く — to have versatile skills/qualifications
・{無理|むり}が{利|き}く — to be able to push oneself
